host: NIMBI – Danish Institute for Game Development
summary: Spilfremme provides grants to support activities that advance Danish digital games and the broader games industry, including spreading awareness, enhancing skills and knowledge, promoting Danish game culture, and fostering professional dialogue. The funding helps improve the quality and reach of Danish games by supporting diverse projects such as events, publications, and promotional initiatives.
eligible_applicants: Researchers and others involved in Danish game development
reporting_requirements: Recipients must report on the use of the grant and outcomes of the funded activities.
